dataset.title: Induction of senescence renders cancer cells highly immunogenic

findings.message: The bundle holds 44 where the producer reported 43 (ingest manifest: files). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.

The bundle holds 1.41815e+06 where the producer reported 1.41336e+06 (provenance.json id_rate.ms2 / results.txt All MS2 Scans). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.
94.46% of protein intensity in the worst file, 30.30% median across 43 files (DEF-QC-9 v3.5)
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 2005/1413356 = 0.14% of MS2 identified (S3)

No experimental design file, so quantification treated every raw file as its own condition. Between-group comparisons are not available for this dataset. Producer's note: FlashLFQ treated each file as its own biorep under one blank condition; no normalization; not usable for condition comparisons (owner: QuantProject projection)
No SDRF was found for this dataset, so each run was given a synthetic sample of its own. There is no sample metadata: treat every sample as unannotated.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 2 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.
The search did not write an SDRF back out, so sample metadata comes from the deposited SDRF only. Producer's note: no reanalysis SDRF written (WriteSdrf is MetaMorpheus #2816, unreleased)

dataset.summary: PXD034059 is a DDA label-free dataset (Mus musculus) with 44 runs, 44 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. At 1% FDR the search reports 2,005 PSMs, 77 peptidoforms and 50 protein groups, and the repository holds 118 PTM sites for it. 8 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
